bayts.text: A rain that has benefited whoever sought benefit, a lion that has annihilated the cunning foes.
His are the noble merits, his the wonders, his the marvels, without end.
A gazelle speaks to him, a lizard greets him, a bird reveres him, as one endowed with intelligence would.
A tree walks (towards him), rain gushes forth (at his call), a well overflows without a rope.
A (palm) trunk yearns for him and moans for him, a wolf comes forward to tend the sheep.
He attained glory from the time he made the Night Journey (al-Isrāʾ) in his body, openly, without falsehood.
How magnificent is the Lord who made the Beloved (Muḥammad) journey by night, for nearness (to Him), in purity!
He spent the night journeying after purification, bringing lasting joy among the Prophets.
The night journey of the Trustworthy (Muḥammad) with the Trustworthy (Gabriel), upon the trusty mount (al-Burāq), to the elect.
It erased error, made Majesty manifest, made Beauty manifest to the God-fearing.
They placed him before them (as imām) when they met him, and honoured him, they who possess purity (the Prophets).
He became their master, stood apart from them, and was kept (beyond) them after the ascent.
He returned that same night, poured out gifts, surpassed every torrent (of grace), from Him (Allah) who possesses Permanence.
He came with provisions for the people of good, while the people of wretchedness returned with harm.
He attained perfection, surpassed all men, crossed every arena, crowned with the turban (of honour).
He attained majesty, he attained beauty, from Him (Allah) who is the Most High, Lord of heaven.
How noble is the Exalted one (Muḥammad), protector of my family, shepherd of men, fortress of women!
How excellent a Great One! How excellent a Generous One! How excellent a stay for the chiefs!
He keeps from the Deceiver (Satan), erases delusions, grants piety without delay.
He builds the dwellings together with good things, and desires joy for those who sit with him.
To him my eulogy after my success, in the morning and in the evening.
A blessing of six (verses), with a eulogy of six (verses), reaches him without fail, following the example (of the pious).
May the Lord who glorified him send blessing upon him, and he has surpassed all among the God-fearing.
May (God) pour His peace upon him, make his station august and magnify his reward among the discerning.
Upon the Freed One (Al-ʿAtīq, Abū Bakr), gateway of the Path, brother of trust, be all good pleasure.
Upon the Vizier (ʿUmar), sword of the Bearer of glad tidings (Muḥammad), be the good pleasure of the All-Powerful, who carries out the Decree.
Upon the Light (ʿUthmān), brother of modesty, be the most excellent good pleasure of Him (Allah) who possesses Permanence.
Upon the Kinsman (ʿAlī), lion of battles, be the good pleasure of the Answerer (Al-Mujīb), with an ascent (in rank).
Upon the Companions, who answered (the call), on the day of anguish, be the good pleasure of praise.
How excellent the men! Theirs is the arena (of glory): they were struck and they struck in the hour of trial.
May the good pleasure of the All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ) be upon them all, on the Day of humility, on the Day of the Call.
Masters of good, masters of harm, for whoever seeks provision or whoever seeks aggression.
Each of them is valiant, has a following, and holds exaltation in the time of harmony.
How excellent the armoured warriors! How excellent the defenders! They struck down the enemies without hiding.
Through them I have forgiven and not been harsh; through them I have repelled the slanderers.
The harm-bearing enemies turn towards others than me, by leave of the best one (Muḥammad), effacer of arrogance.
I have entrusted my affair to Him (Allah) who preserves my life, together with the people of Badr, without any doubt.
Truly I declare it: whoever assails with boldness does not turn against me.
O Lord of Majesty, O Sublime (Al-Mutaʿālī), O Best of Protectors, answer my supplication.
Pour forth blessing and peace upon him (Muḥammad) to whom (God) spoke; protect my dwellings and guard what I have gathered.
Upon the Messenger, gateway of access to the attainment of what one asks, the most protective of shepherds.
Pour forth Your blessing perpetually, increase peace, and accept my pens and my edifice.
O Lord of Will, O Lord of Benefit, make happiness everlasting for me, through Your care.
Keep me from aggression, increase me in right guidance, increase me in following (the Prophet), without toil.
Make pure my hidden life, without harshness on my part; make good my supper, make good my midday meal.
O Lord of Existence, be with me in generosity, and let my night vigil (hujūd) go beyond what is due.
Grant me love (of You), lead to me what I desire, O You who have bestowed benefit without wage.
Grant me piety, keep me from the Deceiver (Satan): (make me) a servant who is a joy to whoever beholds him.
Accept my pens and receive my words with praise, without blame upon me and without doubt.
Make my tongue upright, illumine my heart, purify my hopes and increase my innocence.
You have removed harm from me, led provisions to me: so keep me from the injustice of whoever makes a show.
Rescue my family from error, and through what is lawful make my wealth everlasting.
Keep me from reproach, lead to me the Book (the Qur'an) and accept my repentance, O You who have purchased (the souls of the believers).
O Best of Lords, Best of those who nurture, You have gladdened my heart after I asked You for Your gifts.
Pour forth blessing and peace upon him (Muḥammad) who completes (Prophethood), and preserve my whole being, without end.
